summary: The diff implements the requested overlay scoping and lifecycle hardening: ViewActivationOverlay now renders only when the current view matches the activation target, activation is finished when Dashboard’s initial queries settle, activation is cancelled on Dashboard unmount and on logout, and the activation context adds a safety timeout plus dev-only console logging. However, the diff also includes multiple unrelated feature additions/changes (MathJax support, major Admin/Test/Result functionality, Tailwind theme extensions, etc.) that were not requested for the overlay regression fix.
